newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-RESULTS OF CURRIE CUP MATCHES.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-RESULTS OF CURRIE CUP MATCHES.

text.p: Results from the quarter finals of the Currie Cup matches played on Saturday.
In Durban: Natal beat Griqualand West 51-3 (halftime 32-3)

Natal - Tries: Thierry Lacroix, Andre Joubert (2), James Small, Jeremy Thompson, Joss Joubert, Robert du Preez. Conversions: Lacroix, Henry Honiball. Penalties: Honiball, Lacroix (2). Drop goal: Andre Joubert.
In Johannesburg: Transvaal beat Western Province 56-22 (halftime 16-14).
Transvaal - Tries: Jannie van der Walt (4), Joe Gillingham, Hennie le Roux, Bennie Nortje. Conversions: Gavin Lawless (6). Penalties: Lawless (3).
Western Province - Tries: Justin Swart, Pieter Rossouw, Joggie Viljoen. Conversions: Louis Koen (2). Penalties: Koen.
In Friday night's quarter-finals Northern Transvaal beat Boland 55-23 and Free State defeated South Eastern Transvaal 21-3.
In the semi-finals Free State meet Natal in Durban while Transvaal take on Northern Transvaal in Pretoria on October 19.
